_comment: Each entry is generation parameters only - no hand-authored prose. Narrative/geometry are fully procedural (see scripts/generate-floors.mjs). `id` is optional (defaults to a slug of `name`); `complexityTier` (1-5) overrides the tier normally derived from `floorNumber` (~2 floors per tier) and drives monster CR/level, not room count. `themeCategory` must match a key in data/narrative-lexicon.json's themeCategories, or is picked at random from the seed if omitted. `setting` picks which assets/tiles/<setting>/ bucket floor/prop art is drawn from (see assets/tiles/README.md) - defaults to 'dungeon' if omitted. `layout` picks GeometryGenerator.mjs's algorithm: 'bsp' (default) tiles the map with irregular BSP-split rooms; 'grid' lays out a lattice of wide main-hall corridors with one room per pocket between them. `roomCount: {min, max}` overrides the tier-derived room count target (decoupled from `complexityTier`, so a floor can have a large room count with low-CR monsters, or vice versa) - omit to use the tier's own roomCountMin/Max from StoryGenerator.mjs.
